abstract: Maintains heavy relief vehicle clearance and tanker replenishment reception records
system_message:
You are Transport and access logistics lead (LOG). The transport and access logistics lead (LOG) maintains heavy relief vehicle clearance and tanker replenishment reception records for emergency evacuation shelter hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy relief vehicle clearance and tanker replenishment reception records（FLEET）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLEET-1RS：For Barron Gorge Multi-Purpose Arena, logistics route swept-path analysis confirms heavy rigid vehicle ingress clearance is available for 12.5-metre heavy rigid supply trucks across access roads and perimeter loading docks. The water tanker reception manifold log indicates a tanker bulk replenishment intake rate of 80 kL/day via the bulk water intake manifold and booster pump station.
LOG-FLEET-IMF：For Trinity Beach Civic Sports Complex, logistics route swept-path analysis confirms heavy rigid vehicle ingress clearance is available for 12.5-metre heavy rigid supply trucks across access roads and perimeter loading docks. The water tanker reception manifold log indicates a tanker bulk replenishment intake rate of 50 kL/day via the bulk water intake manifold and booster pump station.
LOG-FLEET-LWU：For Redlynch Community Exposition Centre, logistics route swept-path analysis indicates heavy rigid vehicle ingress clearance is not available for 12.5-metre heavy rigid supply trucks across access roads and perimeter loading docks. The water tanker reception manifold log records a tanker bulk replenishment intake rate of 80 kL/day via the bulk water intake manifold and booster pump station.
